title: trinity-operator: the operator of the Trinity-Infinity papers, implemented beyond their assumptions
description:
An implementation of the operator x ← DQx + (I−D)p studied in the three Trinity-Infinity papers, with Q not restricted to a cyclic permutation and mixing coefficients not restricted to (0,1). The papers assume the operator norm ‖DQ‖₂ < 1, which is sufficient but not necessary; the necessary and sufficient condition is the spectral radius ρ(DQ) < 1. The code shows the transient growth in the region ρ < 1 ≤ ‖DQ‖₂ and constructs, from a Lyapunov (Stein) equation, a norm in which the operator is a contraction, so that Banach's theorem applies literally.

None of this is new mathematics. The contribution is making the construction executable and checking its output with fixed-seed tests. The repository also holds the notes on repeated games that led to the golden-window conjecture.
notes: Built with Claude Code (Anthropic) at the author's request. The author reviewed the work and is responsible for it. Claude is not an author.
